node.statement: For the explicit datum of node 1.1.2, the scale bounds and dominated errors supplied there, together with the W witness choices of node 1.1.1 and the hypotheses of node 1, meet lem-maincb-cross-datum-bijectivity. Therefore all four fixed level-one corner maps of that Stage-3 amplified four-corner datum are bijective.
